stem:
There were 5 children at the park. Some were wearing hats and some were not.

| Girls | Boys |
| --- | --- |
| Maria was wearing a hat | Peter was wearing a hat |
| Megan was not wearing a hat | Chan was not wearing a hat |
| Mandy was not wearing a hat | |

Complete the table to show the number of boys and girls that were wearing hats and were not wearing hats.

| | Hat | No hat |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Boys | | |
| Girls | | |

codes.response:
Boys: 1 hat, 1 no hat } or equivalent tallies
Girls: 1 hat, 2 no hat }
